agent_explanation: Force clamp works on most steps (forces pinned exactly at fmax=5.796 at steps 130-131) but is bypassed intermittently, emitting raw kp*velocity-error demand (25.57 at step 132, ~4.4x limit). Lowering kp removes the violation because raw demand never exceeds fmax. Likely cause: clamping applied on outer step but substepped physics integration (substeps_in_step=2) recomputes/applies unclamped force on a substep.
